````text
# #1954: Patch: a glove cursor and playmat-specific field taps
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What

Three client-only changes to how the board feels under the pointer. Everything is in `apps/web`: no engine, card, catalog or spec work, and nothing reads rules or hidden state (CLAUDE.md rule 7).

1. **A glove cursor**, like Hearthstone's gauntlet hand.
2. **One tap per click.** Right now holding the button and dragging over the empty field adds a sand mark and a crunch every 7 px (`SAND_FEEL.minimumTrailDistancePx`), and `sand` skips the engine's retrigger and voice limits (`rapid` in `audio/engine.ts`), so a drag gets very loud.
3. **Field taps that match the equipped playmat**, each with its own mark and sound.

## Where things are now

- `apps/web/src/game/SandSurface.tsx` is the fidget layer under the cards. `down` adds a dimple plus grains and plays `playSfx("sand", { variation, sandVariant, sandBuild })`. `move` adds a trail mark and another crunch each time the pointer moves `minimumTrailDistancePx`. `SLAM_SAND_EVENT` (#185) draws cracks and craters.
- `apps/web/src/game/Board.tsx:653,701` puts the playmat on `.field` as `data-table` (left off for the default `table-tavern`) and mounts `<SandSurface field={field} disabled={sandDisabled} />`.
- `apps/web/src/game/board.css` (`.sand-mark*`, `@keyframes sand-settle`) styles the marks. `apps/web/src/game/table.css` gives each `data-table` its look.
- `apps/web/src/audio/sfx.ts` has the `sand` recipe (about line 783) and its `SFX` entry (`sand: { recipe: sand, durationMs: 240, gain: 0.52 }`). `audio/types.ts` holds `sandVariant` and `sandBuild`, and `audio/engine.ts` (about line 457) holds the `rapid` path.
- The playmats come from `apps/web/src/wire/generated/cosmetics.ts` (`kind: "table"`). That file is generated from `crates/server/cosmetics.json`, so don't edit it.

## 1. Glove cursor

- Draw an **original** cartoon glove/gauntlet hand with the index finger pointing up-left. Don't copy or trace Blizzard's art. Make three SVGs of at most 32×32 px, each with its hotspot on the fingertip:
  - `glove`: the default.
  - `glove-point`: pressed or pointing. Use it wherever the CSS says `cursor: pointer` today.
  - `glove-grab`: a closed fist. Use it where the CSS says `grab` / `grabbing` today, including the drag's `grabbing !important`.
- Define them once in `apps/web/src/index.css` as custom properties (`--cursor-glove`, `--cursor-glove-point`, `--cursor-glove-grab`). Each is `url(…) <x> <y>, <keyword>`, keeping the old keyword as the fallback. Set the default on `html`, and point every `cursor: pointer | grab | grabbing` declaration under `apps/web/src` at the matching property. That is about 74 declarations. Leave `not-allowed`, `text`, `help`, `zoom-in` and `default` as they are.
- Apply the glove only under `@media (pointer: fine)`. Touch and pen are unchanged.

## 2. One tap per click (all playmats)

- A tap happens only on `pointerdown`: one mark set and one sound per press, per pointer. Holding or dragging adds nothing. Remove the drag trail: the `move` handler, `minimumTrailDistancePx` and `.sand-mark--trail`. Fast separate clicks still each tap, and the `build` pile-up across quick clicks (`settleMs`, `maximumBuild`) stays.
- Every rule in `isEmptySurfaceTarget`, `disabled` and `data-dragging` stays as it is.

## 3. Taps by playmat

Map each playmat to a **tap family**. Each family has one mark style and one SFX recipe, and playmats that feel alike share a family:

| Family | Playmats | Mark | Sound |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sand` | `table-tavern`, `table-desert-sand` | today's dimple + grains, unchanged | today's `sand`, unchanged |
| `wood` | `table-wood`, `table-chessboard` | a small, quick ring or ripple. No lasting dent, no grains | a hollow wood knock: a short pitched body thump plus a click transient |
| `felt` | `table-felt` | a soft round press that slowly eases back out. No grains | a muffled, low-passed soft thud |
| `stone` | `table-marble`, `table-obsidian-slab` | a tiny bright chip-spark or dust flick that fades fast | a hard, bright rock tap: a short click with a high resonant ping |
| `neon` | `table-neon-grid` | a glowing ring burst in a random hue from cyan/magenta/lime/yellow | an electronic blip with a short pitched zap |
| `parchment` | `table-ancient-map` | a small sepia ink blot that bleeds outward a little, then fades | a dry papery tap: a short crinkle of high-passed noise over a soft paper thump |
| `astral` | `table-astral` | a few tiny stars (white/violet/pale blue) that scatter from the tap point and twinkle out | a soft shimmering chime: a short bell partial with a faint sparkle tail |

- Keep one lookup, exported from one module (for example `TAP_FAMILY: Record<tableId, TapFamily>` next to `SandSurface`), with `sand` as the fallback for an unknown or new playmat. `SandSurface` gets the playmat from `Board` as a prop. Rename it only if that is cheap; if you rename it, update `Board.tsx`, `Game.tsx` and `Board.test.tsx` with it.
- Family is the only thing that varies. The `variation`, `variant` and `build` inputs feed every recipe so repeated taps never sound identical. Draw the neon hue and the astral stars' positions and colours from the same deterministic `variationFor`, not `Math.random`, so tests can check them.
- Add the new SFX ids (`tapWood`, `tapFelt`, `tapStone`, `tapNeon`, `tapParchment`, `tapAstral`) to `SFX_IDS` and `SFX` in `audio/sfx.ts`. Use the same short, low gain as `sand`, and put them on the same `rapid` path as `sand` in `audio/engine.ts` (an id set rather than `id === "sand"`). Clicks can stay quick now that only a press makes a sound. Reuse the existing recipe helpers (`kit`, `noiseSource`, `biquad`, `tone`, `fmBell`, `envelope`) rather than adding new ones.
- #185's slam cracks and craters keep their current look on every playmat. They are out of scope here.
- Reduced motion (`prefers-reduced-motion` and `[data-reduce-motion="true"]`, as `board.css` and `animations.css` already handle it): the marks may still appear, but neon's burst, astral's scatter and the other new motion collapse to a static mark that fades. Sounds are unchanged.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Vitest (`Board.test.tsx` or a `SandSurface` test): a press on empty field makes exactly one tap, and a held drag across the field after it adds no marks and no `playSfx` calls.
- [ ] Vitest: for each of the 10 `kind: "table"` ids in `COSMETICS`, a tap plays its family's SFX id and draws that family's mark class. An unknown table falls back to `sand`.
- [ ] Vitest (`audio/engine.test.ts`, like the `sand tap` case near line 530): each new tap id plays in a rapid burst, and its recipe renders without throwing.
- [ ] `index.css` defines the three cursor properties. No `cursor: pointer`, `grab` or `grabbing` is left under `apps/web/src` outside those definitions. A grep in a test or a lint is fine.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` pass.
- [ ] Screenshots in the PR of the glove cursor states and of a tap on wood, felt, stone, neon, parchment and astral.
